meta.title: Al Sharq Youth · Join the network
meta.description: Al Sharq Youth is a global ecosystem that connects and empowers young leaders and changemakers. Join a hub, establish a hub or join a stream.

hero.eyebrow: Join the Al Sharq Youth network
hero.title: A generation shaping the future.
hero.lede: Al Sharq Youth is a global ecosystem that connects and empowers young leaders and changemakers. Together, they advance political, economic, and social reform, cooperation, and integration.
hero.networkLabel: A network of connected people and hubs

about.title: Inspire. Empower. Connect.
about.body: Al Sharq Youth brings young leaders and changemakers into one global network. It is a space to join the conversation, find your people, grow as a leader, and advance ideas and initiatives.
about.philosophy: A network model, believing that networks are faster, smarter, and more resilient in an unpredictable, complex world.

path.title: Your path to impact starts here!
path.lede: Al Sharq Youth creates impact through:
items: Join the conversation. Take part in Diwans, public dialogues, and thought-provoking discussions.
Find your network. Take action. Connect with changemakers worldwide, join hubs, and collaborate on activities and initiatives.
Grow as a leader. Build for impact. Explore the Al Sharq Youth streams.
Take impact further. Collaborate with others to advance ideas and initiatives.

streams.title: Ways to grow with Al Sharq Youth

F.name: Fellowship
F.line: A leadership journey: six modules on ideas, systems, media and leading in uncertain times, with thinkers and practitioners.

I.name: Impact
I.line: Turn an idea into a community initiative in your hub, with workshops and mentors. No existing project needed.

H.name: Hubs
H.line: Local, city-based spaces where members meet, host discussions and run projects that create local and regional impact.

streams.note: Applications for the programs and hubs open after Al Sharq Forum 2026. Register your interest below and we will contact you.
